records.claim_text: JGA offers tailored payroll talent acquisition and client support; its aggregate retention and review claims are not adopted as measured R02 outcomes.
records.locator: JGA Payroll Recruitment; The JGA Advantage
records.interpretation_limits: Employer-facing recruitment service declaration. No dates, cohort or independent placement outcome verification.

records.claim_text: Permanent operational recruitment, temporary/project cover and senior leadership search are distinct declared routes; its outsourced recruitment process is not outsourced payroll processing.
records.locator: Permanent; Temporary/Contract; Executive Search; Client Solutions
records.interpretation_limits: Declared recruitment models and assessment approach. Immediate support language is not a guaranteed fill time or proof of available talent.

records.claim_text: Interim/permanent payroll recruitment spans operational, implementation, leadership and auto-enrolment specialisms. Listed role/sector examples demonstrate inspectable publisher claims, not a complete capability census.
records.interpretation_limits: Published role/sector examples and aggregate performance claims are self-published, not independently audited. Page scope does not establish the cause of any need.

records.claim_text: The current live page describes permanent appointments, interim leadership and transformation work, with technical capability, leadership judgement and stakeholder influence assessed. Recruitment analytics and brand-perception reporting are separate from employer payroll outcome evaluation.
records.locator: Payroll Search on a Global Scale; Beyond the Shortlist; Post Project Report
records.interpretation_limits: Live page wording differs from indexed/search and earlier page text. Use the live retained body for current scope. Declared expertise and reporting do not establish achieved placement or payroll performance.

records.claim_text: Payroll sits within broader finance recruitment offering permanent/interim/contract routes, alongside systems, transformation and workforce planning language. Broad coverage does not prove fit for a particular payroll mandate.
records.locator: Specialists in accountancy and finance recruitment; Roles we recruit for
records.interpretation_limits: Broad finance page includes payroll. Adjacent finance case studies and workforce services cannot be treated as payroll-specific results or executive search availability.

records.claim_text: UK finance recruitment includes Payroll Manager, permanent and temporary/interim staffing; the page separately describes consulting with Protiviti. Staffing a role, owning a change programme and running payroll remain different contracts/outcomes.
records.locator: Choose your ideal hiring model or consultancy solution; FAQ on roles; temp/contract finance talent
records.interpretation_limits: Finance-wide service/consultancy scope. UK Payroll Manager inclusion is not evidence of a US Payroll Director placement. Generic performance claims and current salary-guide labels are not adopted.

records.claim_text: The London aosphere de-merger case describes HR/payroll structure rebuilding and supplied interim and permanent talent. This is a specific publisher-reported example of maintaining operations during organisational change, not proof of sector-wide outcomes.
records.locator: The challenge; The solution; The outcome; Roles; Region
records.interpretation_limits: Publisher case and named client testimonial, not independent audit. No comparable cost, duration, payroll error or continuity metric supplied. Main payroll landing page timed out repeatedly; its current broad claims are not silently carried forward.

records.claim_text: The advertised role combines payroll inputs, statutory submissions, control-account reconciliation, pension schemes, audit and corrective action. This illustrates domain-specific task fit and temporary cover without implying an extra person alone resolves the process.
records.locator: Job duties; Key Skills; Posted 12 October 2026
records.interpretation_limits: Recruiter-published vacancy for an independent school, six-month FTC. An advert is evidence of a requested role, not completed hiring, realised shortage or achieved performance. No salary benchmarking inference.
